notes: Vendor prices are now built in — brand multipliers apply automatically (147 brands), with tiered brands (Kohler, Newport Brass, TOTO, etc.) prompting per order with their note and a Variable toggle. New brands can be matched to an existing brand if the quote used a wrong name. Setup → Change Pricing Rules can delete or combine brands. Log → Send Logs to Support uploads your log and emails it to support. Fixed cut-off buttons in every dialog. (PDF showroom-quote import remains a beta-only feature for now.)
